title: Questions 186-190 refer to the following article, letter, and memo.
passage_1:
Halberd Materials Plans New Bioplastics Plants

March 8 (Rotterdam)—Halberd Materials announced plans to build and operate a large bioplastics plant in southern Portugal. Chief executive Ingrid Vasco thanked the Portuguese government, saying, “The combination of investment allowances and direct grants turned this project from an idea into something we could build.” She added that the Evora site, which Halberd bought for €22 million, is ideal. Although it is remotely situated—more than 180 kilometres from the nearest city—the site is conveniently located near both a freight railway and a motorway. That will make it useful to transfer equipment and materials in and out. The M4 Bioplastics Plants is expected to produce up to 90,000 tons of material on a yearly basis and is planned to start operations early next year.

Nuno Ferreira
Halberd Materials
Rua do Alecrim 44, Lisboa

4 November

Dear Mr. Ferreira,

Enclosed with this letter is the environmental compliance report for the 120,000-ton M4 Bioplastics Plants at Evora. Overall, my department was impressed by your efforts to meet every relevant regulation. There are, however, two problems that must be handled:

1. Secondary containment must be fitted around the solvent tanks in case of a leak.

2. Further air-quality monitors must be installed across the site. The report gives the exact positions.

On 10 December, a member of my team will return to the factory to confirm that these problems have been resolved. Please contact me with any questions.

Yours sincerely,

Beatriz Salgado
Directorate of Industrial Standards, Lisbon

MEMORANDUM

To:All Halberd Department Heads
From:Nuno Ferreira, Director of Operations
Date:15 December
Subject:M4 Bioplastics Plants

The M4 Bioplastics Plants will start production on 8 March as planned. There was some concerns about a delay because of the problems raised by the Directorate of Industrial Standards, but our lead engineer, Petra Nowak, saw to them before the 10 December deadline. I am very grateful to her.

On a related point, we still have several shift supervisor positions needed to be filled at the facility. Please check the e-mail I sent last week detailing the requirements. If there is someone you would like to recommend, please contact me by 20 December. Thank you.
